source.note: Descriptions transcribed from the supplied reference image. Navamsa description combines its continuation across the page break.

divisions.name: Drekkana
divisions.description: Everything related to brothers and sisters

divisions.name: Chaturthamsa
divisions.description: Residence, houses owned, properties and fortune

divisions.name: Ashtamsa
divisions.description: Sudden and unexpected troubles, litigation etc

divisions.name: Navamsa
divisions.description: Marriage and everything related to spouse(s), dharma (duty and righteousness), interaction with other people, basic skills, inner self

divisions.name: Dasamsa
divisions.description: Career, activities and achievements in society

divisions.name: Dwadasamsa
divisions.description: Everything related to parents (also uncles, aunts and grand-parents, i.e. blood-relatives of parents)

divisions.name: Trimsamsa
divisions.description: Evils and punishment, sub-conscious self, some diseases

divisions.name: Shashtyamsa
divisions.description: Karma of past life, all matters
